summary: Refill corrected mission duration windows without hydrating all historical claims

replay.detail: Dirty runs recompute only affected definition-hash and step-path windows, restoring previously evicted valid samples after deletion, failure or completion-time correction.

schema.detail: Advance the local ETA initialization marker to version 2 so existing stores refill retained windows. Historical candidates are traversed newest-first using terminal timestamp metadata; claim bodies are loaded only until older candidates cannot enter the latest 64 samples.

rules.detail: Selected-attempt timing and advisory-only estimates remain unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No wire fields, claim kinds or serving schemas change.

downtime.detail: Initialization runs during normal store opening without a destructive migration.

recovery.detail: Derived samples can be rebuilt from retained claims; original data is unchanged.
